QuestInfo.name: Where is this place? Who am I?
QuestInfo.0: There is a temple keeper in Temple of Time who has lost their memory. Maybe the memory was erased like Alpha? Go see the Amnesiac Temple Keeper.
QuestInfo.1: The Amnesiac Temple Keeper tells you that they have no idea who they are and have no clue where they are at.  Go ask people about this priest.
QuestInfo.2: Everyone seems to know about the Amnesiac Temple Keeper but no one tell you anything. You are sure there is more to the story.

speech.0: I don't know how you know the #rAmnesiac Temple Keeper#k, but I'd stay away from him, if I were you.
Memories can't really be lost. They can be put in a corner or covered up, though...
The Amnesiac Temple Keeper? Oh, you must be talking about Kao. You say he's looking for his lost memories? A fool's errand, that. Not...that I would know anything about it.
#rKao#k has been around for a long time. Only the elder keepers know why he lost his memory.

0.0: I can't remember anything. I don't know where I am or who i am or why I don't have my memories! Do you know anything about me? Please, help me...

yes.0: Maybe someone around here knows more about me? Could you find out any anything about me? I'll stay here in case...anyone's looking for me.

no.0: I just can't remember anything on my own...

1.0: Did you find out anything about me?

default.0: Maybe someone around here knows something about me?
